#!/usr/bin/env bash
case "$1" in
  */P1/*) printf '%s\n' "pct=100" ;;
  */P2/*) printf '%s\n' "pct=150.5 (x)" ;;
  */P3/*) printf '%s\n' "pct=0.0 (type-set)" "missing=A" ;;
  */P4/*) printf '%s\n' "pct=+100.0" ;;
  */P5/*) printf '%s\n' "pct=-5" "missing=Q" ;;
esac
